
RESTORE-QUESTION
Restore soft-deleted question by stable ID (undeletes item and clears deletedAt timestamp)

USAGE
  fspec restore-question <workUnitId> <index>

ARGUMENTS
  <workUnitId> (required)
    Work unit ID
  <index> (required)
    Question ID (stable index from show-work-unit or show-deleted)

OPTIONS
  --ids <ids>
    Restore multiple questions with comma-separated IDs (e.g., "2,5,7")

EXAMPLES
  1. Restore deleted question with ID 2
  $ fspec restore-question AUTH-001 2
  ✓ Restored question from AUTH-001
Question reappears at index [2] in show-work-unit

  2. Restore multiple questions at once (bulk restore)
  $ fspec restore-question AUTH-001 --ids 2,5,7
  ✓ Restored 3 questions from AUTH-001

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec remove-question
  fspec show-work-unit
  fspec show-deleted
  fspec compact-work-unit

NOTES
  • Uses stable IDs that never shift when items are removed
  • Restoring an already-active item is idempotent (succeeds with message)
  • Non-existent IDs will fail with clear error message
  • Bulk restore validates all IDs before restoring any item
